mechanism: Both drugs are metabolized by hepatic CYP450 enzymes (modafinil is a CYP3A4/2C19 substrate and inducer; primaquine undergoes CYP metabolism), potentially leading to altered plasma concentrations and reduced antimalarial efficacy.
action: Monitor antimalarial efficacy and consider alternative wakefullness agents or adjust primaquine dosing; assess for breakthrough malaria symptoms during concurrent use.
